purpose: Audit whether the recurring family-level component of phylogenetic memory could be explained by family-correlated BIEN source/study composition.
role: Post-outcome sensitivity only. It cannot change the prospective portability/repeatability conclusions and cannot be promoted to a new primary hypothesis.

provenance_unit.rationale: Use BIEN provenance fields already stored on agg_traits; do not infer study identity from trait values.

family_covariates: median_source_HHI across the family's admitted systems

A_context_vs_source_concentration.response: prospective family context score = BLUP-free family mean of trait-centered S3 rho, computed as median over admitted systems of rho_family_trait - leave-family-out mean rho for that trait
A_context_vs_source_concentration.interpretation: A positive association would make source concentration a plausible contributor; a null association does not eliminate source heterogeneity.

B_adjusted_repeatability.inference: descriptive sensitivity; no new p-value threshold

C_source_citation_replication.rule: Repeat A and B using source_citation instead of source where feasible.

hard_nonclaims: No causal biological family effect is established.
A stable adjusted R_family does not prove source heterogeneity is irrelevant.
A changed R_family does not invalidate the prospective portability result.
Do not select provenance field or covariates by whichever gives the preferred result.
